findings.claim: The caller-declared mandatory TDD cycle must contain valid RED and GREEN phases for the identical focused command.
findings.observed: The supplied canonical proof contains only a RED phase and explicitly reports that the GREEN phase is missing; the checkpoint likewise marks GREEN capture incomplete.
findings.rationale: With tddRequired=true, an incomplete RED-only proof does not establish the required RED-to-GREEN cycle. This is an artifact assessment, not interpretation of a test-suite failure.
findings.required: Supply a valid helper-owned GREEN phase for the identical focused command so the canonical proof records a complete RED-to-GREEN cycle.

findings.claim: Acceptance requires complete supplied visibility of the owned mapper and focused contract tests before their semantics can be evaluated.
findings.observed: The caller-computed diff contract is incomplete and explicitly omits be-document-processing/src/document_processing/audit/audit_page_observations.py and be-document-processing/tests/test_monitor_page_observations.py, the two primary owned implementation paths for this goal.
findings.rationale: The omitted paths prevent a trustworthy semantic review of mapper behavior and contract coverage. Their omission is not evidence that implementation is absent or incorrect, so the issue is typed as incomplete evidence rather than a correctness finding.
findings.required: Provide a complete caller-supplied diff or equivalent review material for the owned mapper and focused test paths, then repeat semantic acceptance.
